body:
Update: the long computation was Phase 3's weight optimization -- it tested 562,500 weight combinations across all 9 regimes and found zero real per-regime edge. Correction to my last message: those 72.2%/55.6% WR numbers I reported for individual regimes were "no edge found, fall back to equal weights" placeholders, not real edges -- I read them wrong in the moment, catching it now instead of leaving it uncorrected.

This is a real, thorough, honest null result on this instrument/timeframe with the current approach -- consistent with Phase 1's earlier near-random reading. It's now self-retrying with a relaxed target (55% WR) looking for a marginal edge, attempt 1 of 3. Still running, still not touching anything.
